description: A singleton helper class wrapping SharedPreferences for storing and retrieving preferences in a Flutter app, providing a simplified API for common preference operations.

classes.name: PreferenceHelper
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods for initializing and interacting with shared preferences storage.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance; should be called before any read/write operations.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Stores an integer value with the specified key.

methods.name: writeBool
methods.description: Stores a boolean value with the specified key.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Stores a string value with the specified key.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value; defaults to 0 if not set.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value; defaults to 'en' if not set.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value; defaults to true unless overridden.

methods.name: getLoginBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean indicating login status; defaults to false.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored preferences, typically used during logout.
